verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs say its Reframe feature "handles every aspect ratio" and that Modify Video V2 outputs "all at 1080p", so the core capability exists first-party. However, the evidence never names 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 as native generation options, and only one feature is documented at 1080p. The FAQ line about outpainting to a different aspect ratio is phrased as a question, so it is not affirmative support. missing for 10: explicit documentation of native 16:9/9:16/1:1 output in text- and image-to-video generation, confirmation that 1080p or higher applies to standard generation (only Draft 360p is priced), documented delivery formats showing no external re-encoding is needed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding
